public_policy: Common preaction enemy reach set includes all legal individual moves and simultaneous arrivals, equal versus strictly lighter enemies considered separately. Only focal burden >=80 and at least one strictly lighter possible captor at original destination can trigger. Use highest ranked validated candidate under frozen Sapling-it50 joint parent; its safe substitute, teammate corridor, multiple enemy and route checks in actions.py. First qualifying root only in a deployed game. No map IDs, actual enemy orders or future outcomes as policy inputs.
positive: Training retrospective positive only if the same worker with at least 80 at root actually transfers >=80 directly to a unique surviving lighter enemy collector in the source action at t through t+3. Trees/bases/ground, equal ties and other destination types excluded. Event traces cover full training games including early turns.
training_selection: All admissible physical t180..295 with public top defensive option. Exclude any previously adjudicated physical t in source inventory, including t287..294 where applicable. Select up to 3 positives on distinct terrain; order by shortest lead then fixed dig(map,seat,worker,t,loaded-defense-v1) and choose without repeated worker trajectories. Select up to 3 distinct-map negative controls among true public opportunities where that same worker is never directly captured in t..t+3; nearest cargo, phase and threat-burden to a positive, prefer same terrain but another seat when available. Distinct roots with at least 10 turns between on a shared trace. No changes based on intervention outcome.
repeatability: On first sorted qualifying rescue and control case preassign a second independent matched opponent random stream, whether favorable or not. Primary means are by physical terrain within each stratum, with repeat streams separately shown. Do not use retrospective effect size as the deployment incidence.
train_gate: If >=1 positive public root exists, measure the frozen positive/control panels to official terminal including second streams. If no positive coverage, stop after documented source/geometry audit. Formal development gate requires >=2 different maps per stratum, >=2 positives and >=2 negative controls; in rescue stratum average original principal directly stolen by enemy worker decreases, focal principal banked rises, official margin rises; in control stratum average official margin >=-10 and own team delivery >=-10. Prespecified positive repeat must also reduce directly stolen starting principal. Both strata are empirical screen only, not a causal frequency over the ladder. Qualification is the binary switch only; no tune on held.
held_gate: Only if train gate passes, validate first deployment trigger in every held seat against exact original historical prefix. If a first dispatch intersects a previously treated excluded turn, that seat is ineligible and held gate cannot pass; do not replace it by a later trigger or claim zero gain. All eight registered map/seats otherwise including true no-trigger zero. Require >=2 changed maps and both physical seats have a change; mean official margin>0 and each seat margin>=0, focal principal direct-to-opponent strictly down, original principal banked strictly up, team deposits not down. All means map-equal. Future native opponent feedback is only a label. Stop on mechanism/coverage/benefit gate failure.
resources: Native worker CPU1 and one shared arena lock, bounded 2100 active seconds across train/held/restarts for this study. At most eight training pairs including two RNG repeats; held at most eight on four different maps. All full terminal incl extinction, root enemy matched from tape, both later policies live, no formal maps or whole-game pilot authorized in this subtask.
